original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 29 Electrical Current Probe structure, its identity/location/status and all applicable current-limit, resolution, tolerance, accuracy and nominal fields against the approved platform specification.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 29 structures through protected read-only OS access, retain SUT/SMBIOS/parser identity, decode every handle and numeric/sentinel field, compare to the expected current-probe matrix and label live current/power readback as supplemental only.
manual_activity: The platform/power owner supplies the expected electrical-current probe inventory, values, units and sentinel rules; an operator verifies target identity and protected access while automation performs the comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS version
Expected Type 29 handle count, descriptions and locations
Expected status, maximum/minimum, resolution, tolerance, accuracy, OEM and nominal values
Documented current units, precision, rounding and Unknown/not-provided sentinel semantics
Supported dmidecode/parser version and raw-field mapping
Protected credential/host verification, redaction and evidence storage
safety_requirements: Keep collection read-only; do not alter power limits, rail settings, thresholds, BIOS or BMC sensor policy
Do not clear logs before relevant baseline evidence is retained
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture complete raw stdout/stderr and exit status; no heading-only grep verdict
Preserve raw numeric encodings before unit conversion or rounding
Do not treat SMBIOS nominal/limit metadata as a live current measurement or infer power without a matched voltage/time basis
Stop on malformed, unit-ambiguous or sentinel-ambiguous data and require owner interpretation
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and expected Type 29 probe matrix
Collect complete raw `dmidecode --type 29` through protected access
Parse every handle, location, status and numeric/optional field
Apply only documented current-unit, precision and sentinel transformations
Optionally correlate separately labelled read-only BMC/OS current or power telemetry
Report comparison and no-mutation audit without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve probe inventory, expected values, units and tolerances
Resolve Unknown, OEM, not-provided or absent entries
Define whether supplemental live current/power correlation is required
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 29 selector matches the source, but grep hides probe and numeric fields, while sshpass plus disabled host checking exposes credentials and weakens target identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated access to run unfiltered `dmidecode --type 29`, retaining complete stdout/stderr, exit status, target identity, parser version and raw numeric values before conversion.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 29 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE29 PROBE MATRIX AND CURRENT SEMANTICS REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a handle-indexed table of every current probe, decode status and raw limit/resolution/tolerance/accuracy/nominal fields with explicit units and sentinels, then compare to SPEC before optional live telemetry correlation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete multi-probe parsing, raw-to-current traceability, secure target binding and inventory-versus-live evidence separation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A decoder heading cannot reveal missing probes, swapped rails, incorrect limits or impossible minimum/maximum relationships.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS values may be static design metadata and can differ from live current telemetry by purpose and update cadence; no power-policy remediation is authorized.

project_override_considerations: If the Project expects zero Type 29 entries, that absence must be explicit. BMC current or power sensors may corroborate identity but cannot replace SMBIOS structure coverage or justify derived power without approved mapping.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/parser identity, timestamp and approved Type 29 matrix
Complete raw Type 29 stdout/stderr and exit status
Parsed handles, descriptions, locations, status and all numeric/optional fields
Raw-to-unit calculations, sentinel handling and field/invariant comparison
Separately labelled optional live current/power correlation plus no-mutation/security audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target SMBIOS Type 29 Electrical Current Probe information. Missing expected inventory and numeric semantics are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 29 collection and comparison are deterministic once the probe matrix, units and parser policy are supplied.

review_improvement: Retains the correct Type 29 read while adding all probe/numeric fields, raw-to-current traceability, protected identity and separation from live power telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: Electrical-current probe metadata is meaningful only when each handle is bound to the intended rail/location and raw values are decoded with the correct unit and sentinel policy. A live wattage or amperage snapshot is time-dependent and cannot prove these firmware inventory relationships.
